explanation: The indicial equation is λ(λ+3)=0, so λ=-3. Equating coefficients gives n(n-3)a_n+3a_{n-1}=0. Option e follows only for n≠3, and is undefined at n=3. Moreover, a_1=3a_0/2 and a_2=9a_0/4, whereas n=3 requires a_2=0, contradicting a_0≠0. Thus no displayed option satisfies the stated request for all n≥1; a nonzero Frobenius solution with leading exponent -3 requires a logarithmic term.
